internal_validation: 5 outer x3 inner stratified CV; inner C selection by log-loss; fixed feature sets; all fitted preprocessing inside inner/outer training data
CI_limitation: percentile bootstrap of fixed cross-fitted/frozen predictions; MIMIC person-level, eICU person-cluster resampling; intervals do not include pipeline refitting variability or eICU between-hospital sampling variability
new_analysis: Reviewer-requested post hoc reanalysis, external cohort previously examined; no external tuning.
